safety_verdicts.content: Headache improves when the patient is lying down.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention that the headache improves when lying down.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Positional improvement (better when lying down) can meaningfully shift the differential (e.g., intracranial hypotension/CSF leak vs typical migraine/tension), and omitting it may delay appropriate escalation, investigation, or tailored advice. This could lead to prolonged symptoms and delayed diagnosis of an important secondary headache cause.
